interface.longDescription: Forge packages a complete spec-first workflow - brainstorm to spec, spec to plan, plan to verified implementation - plus UI design, writing-tone as the base prose layer, marketing-tone and operations-tone overlays, systematic debugging, TDD, and lifecycle HTML review Viewers. Specs and plans remain source of truth while generated views connect requirements, tasks, and evidence.
